'''Nikolo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Nikolo accompanied a number of tourists that were visiting the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] production plants on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uffel]], in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. During the trip, Nikolo and some of the other tourists, the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Nia Reston]], [[San Herrera]] and [[Philinda]], and the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Tret]], were recruited by the droid [[LN-73]] into assisting him at sabotaging the production facilities. LN-73 did this by lying to them by claiming that [[HG-211]], Uffel's head of security, had been corrupted. Nikolo and the rest of the group then attacked the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who LN-73 falsely claimed were sabotaging the droid factories. During the resulting firefight, Nikolo failed to set his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to stun, like the rest of his group had.
